The Bright Side:
Rapid identification and isolation of infected passengers prevented a wider, more dangerous spread.

This is a WHO/Physical plane issue. The error lies in treating recurring outbreaks as isolated events rather than systemic failures.

Industry operators prioritize high-density throughput over robust sanitation. They use reactive cleaning as a pretext to maintain operations, projecting the blame onto the virus rather than the ship's design.
